# Concurrent Doorbell Race

Two relay polls race on the same completed outbox file. The runtime must keep the import and doorbell signal one-shot.

context: Synthetic scenario. Writes one completed Claude outbox, runs two relay polls concurrently with send_doorbell held briefly, and asserts exactly one doorbell call plus one imported outbox source. This covers the race shape that sequential duplicate-doorbell scenarios do not exercise.
